meta.title: Kapturae | Free online photobooth
meta.description: Kapturae is a free photo booth that runs in your browser. Pick a frame, take a few shots, add stickers or filters, and save a photo strip or GIF. Nothing is uploaded.

hero.sub: A photobooth that runs in your browser. Pick a frame, strike a few poses, and download a strip or a GIF.
hero.keep: Runs in your browser · Nothing uploaded · Download or share

flow.label: How it works
flow.title: 4 steps.
flow.description: Frame, shoot, edit, save. Nothing to install.

frame.title: Pick a frame
frame.body: Classic strip, 2×2 grid, polaroid, and a few more.

shoot.title: Shoot
shoot.body: Camera on, 3·2·1, snap. One shot per slot.

edit.title: Edit
edit.body: Filters, stickers, text, doodles. Don't like one? Retake just that one.

download.title: Download
download.body: Save it as a photo or GIF, or share it straight to your apps. It is all built on your device.

frames.label: Frames
frames.title: Pick your frame
frames.description: The frame sets how many shots you take and how they're laid out.

editor.label: Editor
editor.title: Edit your photos.
editor.description: Someone blinked? Retake that one slot. The rest of your photos and edits stay put.
editor.retake_hint:
Camera comes back on,
other slots stay as they are

gif.label: GIF
gif.title: Why stop at photos?
gif.description: Every shot from your session, stitched into one looping GIF.

data.label: Data & privacy
data.title: Stays on your device.
data.description: Kapturae runs entirely in your browser. The camera feed, your photos and every edit are processed on this device. Our server only sends the app itself.

device.title: Made here
device.body: Photos are taken, framed and edited inside this browser tab. No photo is sent anywhere.

tab.title: Survives a refresh
tab.body: Your session is kept in this tab's browser storage, so a reload doesn't lose your work.

cleared.title: Cleared
cleared.body: Starting a new session clears it. Closing the tab ends it, and anything left behind is cleared on your next visit.

save.title: Download before you go
save.body: Kapturae keeps no copy. Save or share your photos before you close the tab.

share.title: Share from your phone
share.body: Where your browser supports it, Share hands the file straight to your apps.

clear.title: Clear it yourself
clear.body: Clearing this site's data in your browser settings removes everything, any time.

cta.label: Start
cta.needs_value: A camera and a browser. That's it.

not_found.title: This frame is empty.
not_found.body: The page you're looking for doesn't exist. The link may have a typo, or the content has moved.

server.title: Something's jammed.
server.body: The problem is on our side, not yours. Your current session isn't lost as long as this tab stays open. Try again in a moment.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.summary: Your photos never leave your device. Kapturae has no accounts, no cookies and no trackers, and our web server is set up not to keep access logs.

device.title: Your photos stay on your device
device.body: Taking photos, editing them, and making the final print, GIF and ZIP all happen inside your browser. No photo, GIF frame or sticker is ever uploaded to Kapturae's servers.

camera.title: Camera
camera.body: Camera access is used only inside your browser, to show the preview and take your photos. The camera image isn't sent anywhere. The Camera Permission page has the details.

storage.title: Browser storage
storage.body: So a reload doesn't lose your work, the current session (your photos, the short bursts used for the GIF, stickers you add and your edits) is kept in this site's storage in your browser: session storage and IndexedDB. The browser also keeps a copy of the app's own files so it works offline. None of this is sent to us.

clearing.title: Clearing your data
clearing.body: Starting a new session, or leaving one with the close button, clears its data. Closing the tab ends the session, and anything it left behind is removed the next time you open Kapturae in the same browser. You can clear everything at any time by deleting this site's data in your browser settings. The Deleting Your Data page explains how.

server.title: Our server
server.body: Kapturae is hosted on a server (VPS) we rent from WLJ-Cloud. It only sends the app's files to your browser. As with any website, your browser sends your IP address and browser details to receive those files. Our web server is set up not to keep access logs, so we don't record them. The connection passes through WLJ-Cloud's network, which we don't control.

third_parties.title: Third parties
third_parties.body: Kapturae uses no analytics, advertising, error tracking or payment services, and loads nothing from other websites: fonts and icons come from our own server. When you use Share, the file goes to the app you choose, and that app's own policy applies.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: We don't collect your photos or any personal data, so there is nothing of yours on our side to access, correct or delete. If you have a question about your privacy, contact us.

changes.title: Changes
changes.body: If the way Kapturae handles data changes, this page is updated first and the date above changes with it.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.summary: Kapturae is free to use. Your photos are yours, and so is the responsibility for them. Don't use it to harm anyone or to break the law.

service.title: The service
service.body: Kapturae is a free photo booth that runs in your browser. We try to keep it available, but it may change, pause or stop at any time.

responsibility.title: Your photos, your responsibility
responsibility.body: You own the photos you take, save and share with Kapturae, and you alone are responsible for them. That includes getting consent from everyone who appears in a photo before you take, keep or share it.

access.title: We can't see your photos
access.body: Kapturae has no access to your photos. They are made and kept on your device, so we can't view, moderate or delete them, including photos you have shared elsewhere.

watermark.title: The Kapturae name on frames
watermark.body: Some frames show the Kapturae name as part of their design. It does not mean that Kapturae created, approved or endorses a photo, or is connected with what it shows.

prohibited.title: What's not allowed
prohibited.body: Don't use Kapturae to make or share content that is unlawful, harasses or threatens anyone, or infringes other people's rights, including their privacy, likeness or copyright. Don't try to disrupt or abuse the service.

designs.title: Frames and stickers
designs.body: Frame designs, stickers and the look of the site belong to Kapturae. You may use them in your own photos for personal purposes. For commercial use, contact us first.

warranty.title: No warranty
warranty.body: Kapturae is provided “as is”, without warranties of any kind. To the extent permitted by applicable law, we are not liable for any loss or damage that comes from using it, including lost photos or edits.

law.title: Changes & governing law
law.body: These terms may be updated at any time; the date of the latest update is shown above. They are governed by the laws of the Republic of Indonesia.

deletion.title: Deleting Your Data
deletion.summary: Nothing of yours is on our server. Your session lives in your browser, and you decide when it goes.

cleared.title: When it's cleared for you
cleared.body: Starting a new session, or leaving one with the close button, clears its photos and edits right away. Closing the tab ends the session; whatever it left behind is removed the next time you open Kapturae in the same browser.

yourself.title: Clear it yourself
yourself.body: Delete this site's data in your browser to remove everything at once. Chrome: click the icon to the left of the address, open Site settings, then Delete data. Safari on iPhone: Settings → Apps → Safari → Advanced → Website Data. Firefox: click the padlock, then Clear cookies and site data.

elsewhere.title: Photos you saved or shared
elsewhere.body: Files you downloaded, or sent to another app with Share, are outside Kapturae. Delete them on your device or in that app; we have no way to reach them.

requests.title: Asking us to delete something
requests.body: We hold no photos and no personal data, so there is nothing for us to delete. You're still welcome to ask us anything through the Contact page.

camera.title: Camera Permission
camera.summary: The camera is only on while you take photos, and its image never leaves your browser. You can revoke permission at any time in your browser settings.

why.title: Why we need the camera
why.body: No camera, no photos from it. Your browser asks for permission when you reach the Shoot step.

when.title: When the camera is on
when.body: Only on the Shoot step, or in the editor while you retake a single photo. Your browser or device shows its camera indicator, and the camera turns off as soon as you leave.

recording.title: Is video recorded?
recording.body: Not as a video. While the countdown runs, Kapturae keeps a short burst of small frames, up to three seconds, to make the GIF. The burst and the photo stay on your device and are never sent to a server.

manage.title: How to allow or revoke it
manage.body: Chrome: click the icon to the left of the site address, then change the Camera permission. Safari on iPhone: open Settings, find Safari, then change Camera. Reload the page after changing the permission.

denied.title: If permission is denied
denied.body: The camera can't start, and we show a short guide to turn it back on. You can still add photos from your device instead.

data.title: Data Handling
data.summary: Your photo's journey, from camera to download. It never leaves your device.

capture.title: 1 · Preview & shoot
capture.body: The camera image is shown and captured right in your browser, together with a short burst of frames for the GIF. Nothing is sent to a server.

edit.title: 2 · Edit
edit.body: Filters, stickers, text and frame colours are applied on your device. The unedited photos are kept too, for the ZIP download.

finish.title: 3 · Download & share
finish.body: Your print, GIF and ZIP are put together in your browser and saved straight to your device. Share hands the file to an app you choose. No copy goes to Kapturae.

storage.title: 4 · Until you're done
storage.body: While the session is open it's kept in browser storage, so a reload doesn't lose it. A new session, leaving the session or closing the tab clears it. See Deleting Your Data.

cookies.title: Cookies & storage
cookies.body: Kapturae sets no cookies and uses no ads or third-party trackers. Besides the session data above, your browser keeps a copy of the app's own files so it works offline. That copy holds no photos.

contact.title: Contact
contact.summary: Questions, feedback, or something not working? We read every message.

shared.title: Photos posted online
shared.body: We can't see, moderate or remove photos made with Kapturae, because they never reach us. To report a photo posted somewhere, contact the site or app where it appears.

frame.meta_description: Pick a print size and a frame theme before the camera turns on.
frame.title: Size first, then
frame.note: The frame locks once the photos are taken. You can still change its color in the editor.

shoot.meta_description: Pose in front of the camera. Photos are taken right in your browser, one per slot.
shoot.note: Mix freely: each slot can come from the camera or from your device. Everything can still be swapped in the editor.

camera.denied_body: Allow camera access in your browser settings, then try again.
camera.unavailable_body: Connect a camera, or open this page on a device that has one.
camera.error_body: Another app may be using it. Close that app, then try again.

edit.meta_description: Adjust, filter and decorate your photos. Every edit happens in your browser.
edit.hint_touch: Pinch to zoom · drag to move
edit.hint_item: Drag to move · Delete to remove
edit.hint_eraser: Touch a line to erase it
edit.hint_move: Drop on another photo to swap
edit.hint_none: Tap a photo to select it
edit.select_slot: Select a slot on the frame to zoom, adjust or retake its photo.
edit.no_crop: No cropping — just zoom and move the photo inside its slot.
edit.filter_note: The unfiltered version is kept too, and comes with the ZIP download.
edit.sticker_upload_note: Add your own image as a sticker. You can crop it and remove the background. It stays on this device.
edit.sticker_upload_error: Couldn't read that image. Try a PNG or JPG.
edit.frame_note: The "{name}" design stays. Only its color can change.
edit.filter_pick_slot: Pick a slot on the frame to filter just that photo.

sticker_prep.title: Prepare sticker
sticker_prep.description: Crop it, and remove the background if you like.
sticker_prep.crop_label: Crop area. Arrow keys move it, Shift and arrow keys resize it.
sticker_prep.crop_hint: Drag the box or its corners to crop.
sticker_prep.remove_bg_note: Works best when the subject sits on a plain background.

done.meta_description: Download or share your photo booth print and GIF.
done.title: Done.
done.gif_alt: Animated GIF of every shot in the frame
done.local_body: Everything was put together in this browser. Nothing was uploaded, so this device has the only copy.
done.share_failed: Couldn't open sharing on this device. Download the file instead.
done.note: Kapturae keeps no copy of your photos. Download or share them before you start a new session or close this tab.
done.note_short: Kapturae keeps no copy. Save your photos before you close this tab.

errors.render: Your photos couldn't be put together in this browser. Try again, or use another browser.

done.empty_body: This session's photos are no longer on this device. Start a new session to shoot again.

upload.label: Add photos from device
upload.drop_body: Or choose from your device. Several at once is fine — empty slots are filled in order.
upload.drop_body_single: Or choose from your device. It replaces the slot you're redoing.
upload.pick_many: Choose up to {n} photos at once — empty slots are filled in order.
upload.pick_one: Choose one photo for this slot.
upload.retention: Photos you add stay in this browser. Nothing is uploaded.

problems.format: Unsupported format. Use JPG, PNG, or HEIC.
problems.small: Resolution too small, at least {n} px on the short side.
problems.heic: This browser can't open HEIC yet. Save it as JPG and try again.

library.label: Photos from this session
library.title: Or use a photo from this session
library.note: Replaced photos aren't thrown away — you can pick them again here for the rest of the session.

replace.title: Replace this photo
replace.note: Only this slot changes. Other slots and filters stay as they are.
replace.camera_note: The camera turns on just for slot {n}. The old photo can still be picked again.
replace.camera_hint: Opens the camera; other slots stay.
